sloka: स राक्षसेन्द्रो हरिसैन्यमध्ये नायुध्यमानं निजघान कञ्चित्।उपेत्य रामं सधनुः कलापी सगर्वितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ।। ६.७१.४४ ।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasendro harisainyamadhye nāyudhyamānaṁ nijaghāna kañcit।upetya rāmaṁ sadhanuḥ kalāpī sagarvitaṁ vākyamidaṁ babhāṣe ।। 6.71.44 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa lord, wielding a weapon in the midst of the monkey army, indeed did not strike any, but armed with bow and quiver went with pride towards Rama and spoke.
